//go:build darwin && arm64

package syscall

import (
	"internal/abi"
	"unsafe"
)

const GomadPointerVariants = 6

func GomadPointerSockaddr(p *RawSockaddrAny) (Sockaddr, error) { return anyToSockaddr(p) }

func GomadPointerWritev(fd int, p *Iovec, variant int) (uintptr, Errno) {
	fn := abi.FuncPCABI0(libc_writev_trampoline)
	switch variant {
	case 0:
		n, _, errno := syscall(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2)
		return n, errno
	case 1:
		n, _, errno := syscall6(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2, 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	case 2:
		n, _, errno := rawSyscall(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2)
		return n, errno
	case 3:
		n, _, errno := rawSyscall6(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2, 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	case 4:
		n, _, errno := syscallX(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2)
		return n, errno
	case 5:
		n, _, errno := syscall6X(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2, 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	default:
		panic("invalid pointer fixture variant")
	}
}

func GomadPointerPair(fd int, p *RawSockaddrAny, length *uint32, operation string, variant int) (uintptr, Errno) {
	fn := abi.FuncPCABI0(libc_accept_trampoline)
	switch operation {
	case "accept", "accept-null", "accept-mismatch":
	case "sockname", "sockname-short":
		fn = abi.FuncPCABI0(libc_getsockname_trampoline)
	case "peername", "peername-short":
		fn = abi.FuncPCABI0(libc_getpeername_trampoline)
	default:
		panic("invalid pointer fixture operation")
	}
	switch variant {
	case 0:
		n, _, errno := syscall(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)))
		return n, errno
	case 1:
		n, _, errno := syscall6(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	case 2:
		n, _, errno := rawSyscall(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)))
		return n, errno
	case 3:
		n, _, errno := rawSyscall6(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	case 4:
		n, _, errno := syscallX(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)))
		return n, errno
	case 5:
		n, _, errno := syscall6X(fn, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	default:
		panic("invalid pointer fixture variant")
	}
}

func GomadPointerOption(fd, name int, p *int32, length *uint32, variant int) (uintptr, Errno) {
	fn := abi.FuncPCABI0(libc_getsockopt_trampoline)
	switch variant {
	case 1:
		n, _, errno := syscall6(fn, uintptr(fd), SOL_SOCKET, uintptr(name), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0)
		return n, errno
	case 3:
		n, _, errno := rawSyscall6(fn, uintptr(fd), SOL_SOCKET, uintptr(name), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0)
		return n, errno
	case 5:
		n, _, errno := syscall6X(fn, uintptr(fd), SOL_SOCKET, uintptr(name), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0)
		return n, errno
	default:
		panic("getsockopt requires a six-argument route")
	}
}
